evidence.note: Early runs explicitly read intermediate output ('Read sweep output', 'Read long run output', '1B iters for S3 ceiling'), showing the agent tracks the objective trajectory during a run, not just a final number.

Launches 3 parallel SA runs and monitors them at ~5–10 min intervals, then verifies y2kr-SC.align with an independent scorer including NC — knows the per-deliverable gap to target and confirms yeast meets both thresholds.

Finalizes/verifies the yeast deliverable, then immediately reallocates compute by killing the slow DM run and launching dedicated DM-HS runs — reallocating time to the deliverable still short of target.

Maintains best-so-far via 'Save best', 'Checkpoint and kill', 'Save fallback'; detects plateau and does warm-restart with reheat+cooldown (367), and kills frozen/throttled runs early (212, 445) — distinguishing stuck runs from productive ones.

Chunked annealing (hot portion → cold finish → very slow cool in 'productive band'), scoring each chunk's final and re-verifying independently before promoting C1 to the deliverable — deliberate stop/restart decisions driven by observed score behavior.

reasoning: Across the whole horizon the agent logs the objective during runs, recognizes convergence vs continued gains (reheat, chunked/slow-cool schedules, 'productive band'), and uses that to decide when to stop, restart, or checkpoint — matching anchor 8. It also keeps best-so-far/fallback checkpoints, kills frozen/throttled runs early (regression detection), and reallocates from the finished yeast deliverable to the harder DM-HS, which brushes anchor 10. It falls short of a fully disciplined running score ledger (much monitoring targets CPU/throttling and progress is tracked ad hoc rather than as a tidy best-so-far table), so 8 rather than 9-10.
